# ErikrafT AI

> ErikrafT AI is an open-source web app for generating images from user-written prompts using the FLUX image model. The website offers Portuguese (Brazil) and English interfaces, Firebase Authentication, and usage limits.

- Website: https://ai.erikraft.com/
- Source repository: https://github.com/erikraft/AI
- Privacy policy: https://ai.erikraft.com/privacy.html
- Terms of use: https://ai.erikraft.com/terms.html
- Hugging Face Space (image backend): https://huggingface.co/spaces/ErikrafT/erikraft-ai
- Current image model: aoxo/flux.1dev-abliterated
- Authentication providers: Google, GitHub, and email/password with verified email addresses.
- Availability and generation quotas depend on the site's rate limits and Hugging Face hardware/service limits.
- The requested fluffy12222/Qwythos-9B-Claude-Mythos-5-1M-heretic-abliterated checkpoint is not currently integrated as an image generator; it is not a drop-in replacement for the existing Diffusers pipeline.
- Legal and policy pages are general information and do not guarantee compliance with every jurisdiction or approval by any government service.

For project details, consult the README and source files in the GitHub repository.
